domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
k is an integer and 1 <= k
k is an integer and k <= n
floor refers to the greatest-integer function applied to the real number k*t
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1, for all real numbers t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, and for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n, it holds that floor(k*t) equals k-1.
quantifier_order: for every integer n such that n > 1
for every real number t such that (n-1)/n <= t and t < 1
for every integer k such that 1 <= k and k <= n

variables.name: t
variables.role: real-valued parameter constrained by inequalities involving n

variables.name: k
variables.role: universally quantified index constrained by 1 <= k <= n

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, one has floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n.
